ancient_revolver.name: Ancient Revolver
ancient_revolver.desc: Mechanically frozen. Spiritually inert. Small. Almost toy-like. [WIRING: unsellable; returns if sold.]

ash_bark.desc: [WIRING] Bark from an ash-adapted tree. Warm to the touch, even cold.
ash_bark.name: Ash Bark

ashen_salt.desc: From the Peak. Tastes like the end of a fire. Cures Hollow.
ashen_salt.name: Ashen Salt

blossom_nectar.desc: Blossom's gift. Fully heals the whole party — but it takes a full minute to drink, and the drinker dreams. Out of combat only.
blossom_nectar.name: Blossom Nectar

briar_thorns.desc: [WIRING] A fistful of thorns. They point at you. All of them.
briar_thorns.name: Briar Thorns

broken_sword.desc: [WIRING] Snapped at the hilt. The plant looks at it the way a surgeon looks at a wound.
broken_sword.name: Broken Sword

creep_pod.desc: A soft, harmless pod cluster from the back alleys. Not everything is a fight.

effect.note: Harmless pod cluster. No battle effect yet.

creep_pod.name: Creep Pod

dragon_gold.desc: Golden-dragon gold — the metal the Twins are made from. The only metal that chambers soul-flame without cracking. Forgehold and dragon-linked sources only; never an early seed. [STORY-BOT: late-game discovery-tier material; price set by the balance pass.]
dragon_gold.name: Dragon Gold

empty_mote_vial.desc: [WIRING] An uncharged soul-glass vial, empty and waiting. Bought from Grimley or crafted from 1 glass shard and 2 grave petals; the Still needs one loaded vial per extraction night. [TUNING: buy price is a placeholder; the balance pass sets it.]
empty_mote_vial.name: Empty Mote Vial

fathers_longsword.desc: [WIRING] Mollosar's father's blade, returned by the blacksmith. It will matter at Dragoni.
fathers_longsword.name: Father's Longsword

glass_shard.desc: [WIRING] A shard of soul-glass, melted down and blown into an empty mote vial. Crafting material for the Still's vials. [TUNING: price unset; not sold anywhere.]
glass_shard.name: Glass Shard

grave_moss_poultice.desc: Smells like a churchyard. Works like one too. Heals 40 HP to one creature.
grave_moss_poultice.name: Grave-Moss Poultice

grave_petals.desc: [WIRING] Grave-flower petals, ground into the flux that seals a mote vial's recipe. Crafting material for the Still's vials. [TUNING: price unset; not sold anywhere.]
grave_petals.name: Grave Petals

gravebind_snare.desc: It holds. Everything holds, eventually. Inflicts Rootbound on one enemy — it can't flee or switch.
gravebind_snare.name: Gravebind Snare

house_blend.desc: [WIRING] Won at the dice table. Murray's pride, smoked slow.
house_blend.name: House Blend

iron_beam.desc: [WIRING] Salvaged Council surplus. Heavy enough to hold up a crossing.
iron_beam.name: Iron Beam

ironwood_bark.desc: Bite down. The tree did. Sharply raises defense for 3 turns; lowers speed for the same duration.
ironwood_bark.name: Ironwood Bark

lantern_oil.desc: Standard issue. Restores 8 Vigor to Mollosar. Not for creatures.
lantern_oil.name: Lantern Oil

living_key.desc: [WIRING] Grown, not forged. Opens one locked door, then it's just metal again.
living_key.name: Living Key

mandrake_tea.desc: The mandrakes make it. They apologize for the taste. It's awful. Cures Wilt and Spore-fever.
mandrake_tea.name: Mandrake Tea

moon_ale.desc: Murray's. It helps. It doesn't help. Restores 5 Vigor to Mollosar.
moon_ale.name: Moon-Ale

moonlit_snare.desc: A snare left out under a full moon. The bound creature won't remember being caught.
moonlit_snare.name: Moonlit Snare

nightshade_poultice.desc: Black petals, silver veins. Heals 120 HP to one creature. Tastes like midnight.
nightshade_poultice.name: Nightshade Poultice

rare_herb.desc: [WIRING] A blend-table stake. Smells like somebody else's luck.
rare_herb.name: Rare Herb

rusted_key.desc: [WIRING] Opens nothing anymore. The plant could teach it a new shape.
rusted_key.name: Rusted Key

sap_draught.desc: Thick. Sweet. Don't think about the tree. Heals 80 HP to one creature.
sap_draught.name: Sap Draught

second_bell.desc: A tiny bell. Ring it once. Somebody always turns around. Revives a fallen creature at 50% HP.
second_bell.name: Second Bell

silver_bell_bloom.desc: It doesn't care about you. It never did. That's the point. Draws one enemy attack, wasted.
silver_bell_bloom.name: Silver Bell Bloom

silvered_ore.desc: [WIRING] Veined with something that moves when unobserved. The plant wants it.
silvered_ore.name: Silvered Ore

soul_snare.desc: A woven soul-light snare. Throw at a weakened wild creature to bind it.
soul_snare.name: Soul Snare

spore_sac.desc: Shake well. Throw far. Apologize never. Inflicts Spore-fever on one enemy.
spore_sac.name: Spore Sac

thorn_pod.desc: Grimley grows them for the garden wall. You're borrowing. Deals fixed plant damage to one enemy.
thorn_pod.name: Thorn Pod

widowblade.name: Widowblade
widowblade.desc: [WIRING] A shadow-forged blade taken from Ivy in Death's Garden. Key item; never breedable, never sellable. Story text is Sweet Potato Creature's lane.
